name: TypeScript
description_en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript output.
readme_excerpt: TypeScript TypeScript is a language for application-scale JavaScript. TypeScript adds optional types to JavaScript that support tools for large-scale JavaScript applications for any browser, for any host, on any OS. TypeScript compiles to readable, standards-based JavaScript. Try it out at the playground, and stay up to date via our blog and Twitter account.
